analogy.rationale: Xanthine oxidase (XDH) is expressed mainly in liver and intestine, and its inhibition primarily lowers uric acid and oxidative stress rather than triggering a broad transcriptional program in these cell lines. The closest expected responses are weak and related to antioxidant/anti-inflammatory effects or purine metabolism, with little overlap with the other reference classes.
